sections.title: What run club leads ask us.

items.question: Can my free runs stay free?
items.answer: Yes. {{brand.name}} charges nothing on runs you don’t charge for, every week. The 5% fee applies only to paid tickets, and never passes ₹10,000 in a 30-day billing cycle.

items.question: Do runners need to download an app?
items.answer: No. Runners book on your page and check in at the meeting point. Live moments open in their phone’s browser.

items.question: Can we keep our WhatsApp group?
items.answer: Yes, and most clubs do. Keep chatting there and post your {{brand.name}} link for sign-ups, payments and pods.

items.question: How are pace groups made?
items.answer: Every booking brings a pace. {{brand.name}} builds pods of six to eight at a similar pace and spreads newcomers so no pod is all strangers. You can move anyone before the run.

items.question: Can I charge for some runs and not others?
items.answer: Yes. Each event has its own price, so a free social run and a paid coached session can sit side by side.

items.question: Can I bring my runners across from another tool?
items.answer: Yes. Import your list from any tool. Nothing changes for runners until the morning of the run.
